$comment: Single source of truth for install options. Read by the wizard (site/), parsed by install.sh, enforced by tests/options.bats. See docs/adr/0005-options-schema.md.

choices.label: XFCE
choices.help: Fast and customizable. Recommended, and the best fit for touch and the Fold.

choices.label: LXQt
choices.help: The lightest option, for phones with little RAM.

choices.label: MATE
choices.help: Classic two-panel layout, moderate resource use.

choices.label: KDE Plasma
choices.help: Modern and heavy; wants 6 GB+ of RAM. Compositing is off by default.

options.label: Windows app support (Wine + Box64, about 500 MB)

choices.label: Dark
choices.help: Adwaita-dark widgets and a dark panel.

choices.label: Light
choices.help: Adwaita widgets.

options.label: Desktop DPI
options.help: Leave empty for automatic: 180 on a Galaxy Fold's inner screen, 96 elsewhere.

options.label: Device tweaks
options.help: Each one is safe on phones it doesn't apply to, so all are on by default.

choices.label: Keep Termux awake
choices.help: Holds a wake lock while the desktop runs, so battery savers (Samsung especially) don't freeze it.

choices.label: GPU self-check
choices.help: Checks that Mesa's Turnip driver supports this GPU at every start, and falls back to software rendering instead of crashing.

choices.label: Handle Android's process killer
choices.help: Android 12+ kills background processes and takes the desktop with it. Lifts the limit through root or Shizuku if available, otherwise shows the one setting to change.

choices.label: Samsung One UI audio fix
choices.help: Preloads libskcodec so PulseAudio works on One UI. Skipped on phones without that library.

choices.label: Touch-friendly windows
choices.help: Bigger window borders on XFCE so you can grab them with a finger.

choices.label: Automatic HiDPI
choices.help: Picks a readable DPI for high-density screens such as the Galaxy Fold's, when you haven't set one.

choices.label: VS Code (Code - OSS)
choices.help: Native Termux build with Open VSX extensions.

choices.label: Firefox
choices.help: Web browser.

choices.label: Chromium
choices.help: Web browser.

choices.label: VLC
choices.help: Media player.

choices.label: GIMP
choices.help: Image editor.

choices.label: LibreOffice
choices.help: Office suite (large).

choices.label: Python 3 + pip
choices.help: Python toolchain.

choices.label: Node.js
choices.help: JavaScript runtime and npm.

choices.label: Build tools
choices.help: clang, make, cmake, pkg-config.

options.label: Extra Termux packages
options.help: Comma-separated package names from pkg, e.g. htop,neovim,tmux.

choices.label: Debian environment
choices.help: A full Debian (proot) with your user account and sudo, for software that only exists for regular Linux. Enter it with terminux debian. About 1 GB.

choices.label: Microsoft VS Code (in Debian proot)
choices.help: The official build with the Microsoft extension marketplace. Includes the Debian environment.

choices.label: Cursor CLI (in Debian proot)
choices.help: Cursor's agent CLI needs glibc, so it runs in the Debian proot.

choices.label: NetBird mesh
choices.help: Join a NetBird network without root. The setup key is asked for on the phone, never in this page.

options.label: AI tools
options.help: Coding agents, local models and editor extensions. Add more later with: terminux add

choices.label: Claude Code
choices.help: Anthropic's coding agent for the terminal. Run: claude

choices.label: OpenAI Codex CLI
choices.help: OpenAI's coding agent for the terminal. Run: codex

choices.label: Gemini CLI
choices.help: Google's Gemini agent for the terminal. Run: gemini

choices.label: OpenCode
choices.help: Open-source terminal coding agent that works with many model providers. Run: opencode

choices.label: GrapeRoot (Dual-Graph)
choices.help: Graph-based context engine (MCP) that gives Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and others the right files with fewer tokens. Run: graperoot

choices.label: Aider
choices.help: AI pair programming in your git repos. Installed in the Debian environment. Run: terminux debian -- aider

choices.label: Cursor CLI
choices.help: Cursor's agent CLI, in the Debian environment. Run: cursor-agent

choices.label: Ollama
choices.help: Run local models on the phone: ollama serve, then e.g. ollama run llama3.2:1b

choices.label: llama.cpp
choices.help: Lightweight local inference for GGUF models (llama-cli, llama-server).

choices.label: AI extensions for VS Code
choices.help: Continue and Cline from Open VSX, for the native VS Code (code-oss).

options.label: Start the SSH server on login (port 8022)
Linux username
options.help: Your account inside the Debian environment (with sudo). Lowercase letters, digits, - and _.

choices.label: zsh
choices.help: With the extras below. Used in Termux and in Debian.

choices.label: bash
choices.help: Termux's default.

options.label: zsh extras
options.help: Only used with the zsh shell.

choices.label: Oh My Zsh
choices.help: Framework for zsh themes and plugins.

choices.label: Powerlevel10k
choices.help: Fast, informative prompt. Run p10k configure to style it.

choices.label: Autosuggestions
choices.help: Suggests commands from your history as you type.

choices.label: Syntax highlighting
choices.help: Colours commands as you type, red if they don't exist.

options.label: Show the terminux banner when Termux opens
options.help: Status and the main commands, every time you open Termux.
